No cross-model/profile/protocol score pooling. Claude browser review/grading subscription usage is not included.

world_positive_coverage.limitation: Frozen World host-marker gaps; no retroactive repair or product qualification.

frozen_history: Fable v3 remains unchanged and archived; Opus is the selected judge contract. Cross-judge labels are not evidence of agreement.
withheld: private prompts, outputs, rationales, free-text first-failure details, run database credentials, operator paths, run-specific control maps
private-case names replaced by deterministic within-release aliases
reproducibility: This script deterministically projects the verified private source set. Public hashes do not reconstruct withheld inputs. Public standalone correctness fixtures reproduce harness behavior, not live model outcomes.
limitations: Frozen accepted-input replay is deterministic; new LLM or SUT execution is not guaranteed deterministic.
One Opus contract does not prove judge stability, independence, or universal semantic correctness. Human S1/S2 qualification remains pending and is not a harness delivery gate.
No performance pooling across cohorts, families, models, profiles, protocols or provenance. Coverage totals are not accuracy.
Partial external-effect observability, frozen historical World host-marker gaps, omitted cold-context paths, development exposure, correlated small samples and imperfect blinding remain limits.
Public Opus QA variant is NOT_EXERCISED and NOT_CALIBRATED; official public accuracy remains NOT_TESTED.
Independent effect/no-shell receipts remain authoritative evidence; judge rationales cannot override them.
Replay inputs are local and private and must be retained, or restored and replay-verified before releasing archived originals.

tracked_diff_empty describes only tracked git diff HEAD paths. The source_files_digest also binds untracked nonignored files. Neither an empty tracked diff nor public commit reachability proves that a commit alone reconstructs the recorded source bytes; commit_reproduces_source_digest is untested (null).
Initial snapshot, resource audit and final selected report are distinct snapshots; no model rankings, performance pooling or pass rates are produced.
